findings.note: When --include-untracked is omitted, the implementation passes --no-include-untracked to resolve-component-paths. The upstream CLI contract only defines optional --include-untracked, and REQ-001/AC-004 require verbatim pass-through: omission must remain omission. This can reject ordinary invocations or diverge from the required dependency call.

WARN diagnostics are emitted as collected WARN entries followed by the block-summary entry, without sorting by (id, detail). Because the summary detail is a lexical prefix of the per-node details, this ordering is not the required stable sort; the existing WARN tests encode the incorrect order rather than enforcing REQ-005/AC-024.
